messages:
mike-ops: Quick triage — I'm running an audit-telemetry coverage sweep for API gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. Goal: identify gaps, owners, and what needs schema changes vs just instrumentation. Start with quick pass today, backlog prio tomorrow. :eyes:

jane-sec: SGTM. Can you share the checklist you want us to follow?

mike-ops: Basic checklist: 1) event exist? 2) event contains user_id, principal_type, action, resource, outcome, request_id, timestamp 3) immutability (no PII) 4) retention/forwarding hooks for customer exports.

sara-pd: For console flows we also need UI action-context (e.g., which page, which button). Otherwise customer-facing audit validation fails.

alex-eng: Quick note on runtime: many infra events are inferred from metrics right now, not structured audit events. That will need schema + small agent to emit.

jane-sec: Can we get an agreed minimal schema? I'll paste the snippet I use in SOC playbooks:

```json
{
  "event_type": "string",
  "timestamp": "ISO8601",
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "user": {"id": "string", "type": "user|service|api_key"},
  "action": "string",
  "resource": {"type": "string", "id": "string"},
  "outcome": "success|failure",
  "metadata": {"ip": "string", "user_agent": "string"}
}
```

jane-sec: Minimal fields above. Avoid nesting beyond one level where possible.

mike-ops: Thanks. For customer-facing validation we need to map these fields to our export format (CSV/JSON webhook) and document in support KB.

sec-bot: Incident note: last week we had a missing auth.audit.login event for SSO flows (ticket #INC-2024-115). Logging gap repro steps recorded.

alex-eng: On SSO gap — that's due to the new OIDC proxy change. I can add an emit in proxy on token issue/refresh. Small change but needs KMS consideration for ephemeral keys that sometimes appear in logs.

jane-sec: KMS: do NOT log key material. But log key-id and operation (encrypt/decrypt/sign). For customer audits they sometimes ask which key was used. Key IDs are fine.

sara-pd: Billing: we must ensure all billing-affecting events (plan change, invoice generation, seat changes) have traceable request_id that links to auth events. Product wants transaction_id unified across services.

mike-ops: Proposal: owner matrix per service: API gateway -> alex-eng, Auth/SSO -> jane-sec + alex-eng, Console -> sara-pd + frontend eng (tbd), Billing -> finance-eng (assign), Runtime -> eng-infra. Anyone object?

jane-sec: Approve. I'll own schema validation tests for Auth and a nightly job to surface missing fields.

alex-eng: I'll instrument API gateway and OIDC proxy. Will add a small shim to map headers -> user object. ETA EOD next Wed (1883740000).

sec-bot: Reminder: logging retention and export permissions need RBAC checks. Customer exports can include audit events; ensure only owner-level roles can request full export.

mike-ops: Good catch. Action: add RBAC matrix item to backlog. Also need to decide which events are considered PII-filtered vs allowed.

jane-sec: I'll draft a PII policy for audit events: do redaction at emit-time where possible, otherwise redact at ingestion. Will share PR.

sara-pd: For backlog triage tomorrow: please add tags in the ticket: service, severity (P0/P1/P2), schema-change? (yes/no), owner. We'll run a short poker session and allocate cycles next sprint.

alex-eng: Two technical details: 1) For runtime KV cache invalidation we need to emit cache.invalidate events with resource id + origin node. 2) For high-volume paths we should sample non-essential fields to avoid egress blowup.

mike-ops: Sampling ok but must preserve request_id + outcome. We'll document sampling policy.

jane-sec: For validation harness: I'll put together a small conformance test that can run against a QA environment and assert required keys exist. Something like:

```bash
# pseudo
curl -s $QA_AUDIT_ENDPOINT | jq -c '.events[] | select(.event_type=="auth.login") | {request_id, user, outcome}' | wc -l
```

jane-sec: If conformance fails, pipeline should block canary deploys for that service.

mike-ops: Good. Last: customer-facing validation UI — Sara, can product own which example events we surface for customers and the export schema doc?

sara-pd: Yep. I'll prepare the doc and a short FAQ for support. Aim to have draft by Friday (1883310000).

mike-ops: Recap / action items:
- alex-eng: instrument API gateway + OIDC proxy (emits + key_id logging) — ETA 1883740000
- jane-sec: schema conformance tests + PII policy + nightly missing-field alert — ETA PR by 1883220000
- sara-pd: customer docs + console event context mapping — ETA 1883310000
- finance-eng: assign billing owner and ensure transaction_id propagation (mike will ping)
- infra team: runtime agent design doc for structured events (owner eng-infra)

mike-ops: I'll create tickets with tags now. Post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Created tracking epic: AUDIT-TELEMETRY-COVERAGE-1883. Members will be added automatically.

alex-eng: Added initial PR for API gateway tracing header last night, link: https://git.redwood/internal/rgw/pulls/234 — contains example emit and request_id propagation.

jane-sec: Noted. Will review PR and add schema tests.

mike-ops: Thanks all. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:30am PT for poker triage.

sara-pd: Thanks — adding calendar invite. :calendar:
